descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S01 「给几个住户来回切换 In Today；只有点到的那个住户变，取消标记的住户病历还在」 Toggle In Today on and off for several residents; only the tapped resident changes, and an un-marked resident keeps their chart

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 1；TFA-92587 How it works 1）
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 2；TFA-92587 How it works 2；TFA-92587 How it works 6）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fixture resident (In Today) plus QA Ash (Maple 1, In Today), QA Ashby (Maple 2, In Today, with a vital BP 128/76, a medication row 'Donepezil 10 mg nightly' and an Important Point 'QA point: daughter visits Fridays') and QA Cove (Maple 3, not In Today); one Hospital patient

When All Residents → un-mark QA Ashby → mark QA Cove → Today's Visits → All Residents → open QA Ashby's chart (Pre-Round) → back → All Residents → mark QA Ashby → un-mark QA Cove → Today's Visits

Then Every resident in All Residents has a toggle. After the first round Today's Visits lists QA Ash, QA Cove and the fixture resident, not QA Ashby; QA Ashby is still in All Residents with '+ Today' and their chart still shows the vital, the medication and the Important Point. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint (UAT step 4 'toggle on and off for several residents'): each resident is checked by name on each Today's Visits checkpoint with mustContain / mustNotContain (U5); Today's Visits checkpoints mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' and All Residents checkpoints mustContain it, to prove the tab; …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U13；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
